name: agent-run
title: Agent Run
summary: One task an agent works through: a title with its state and time, opening to the steps, thinking and tool calls.
use_when: Showing the progress of an agent's task while it runs and after it ends
Grouping the steps and tool calls of one task inside a Message
avoid_when: A single tool call: use Tool Call on its own
Progress with a known percentage: use Progress

props.title: ReactNode: the task, "Review project"
props.state: queued | running | completed | failed | cancelled (AgentRun, AgentRunStep, AgentRunThinking)
props.duration: string: how long the run took, "12s"

copy.title: The task as a verb phrase: "Review project"
copy.step: What the agent does, in a few words: "Read the brief"

a11y: The title row is a button that says whether it is open
The running Spinner is a status with a label; finished steps carry their state as a label
